title: Diff-scoped post-fix review of the Story 1.3 cycle-3 remedies
summary: Delta-scoped review (fresh session, review-only) of the ~250-line cycle-3 fix: remedy completeness for the four verified-fixed blockers (ABSENT-terminal durable close, target-arity fail-closed + workspace-trust decoupling, NEEDS_HUMAN latch split, bounded remote git wrapper), new-blocker check on the changed surface, anti-vacuity of the new regressions, contract truthfulness of the rewritten sentences, judgment of the B3 flag-split deviation, and the timeout(1) dependency disclosure. Prior scenarios stay pinned; runnable self-deciding attack scripts with controls; verdict bound to the frozen blocker bar. NOTE: this review freeze-gates Story 1.3 — the surface includes the operation-lock-adjacent EXIT boundary and the dispatch/cleanup authority path; a wrong CLEAN verdict freezes a defect into the increment. Same review class as the five Story 1.2 dispatches (all blast_radius high). First route attempt (attempt1, retained) understated blast_radius as medium and drew local-code-standard, which the frozen launch adapter cannot execute; this is a corrected re-route, not an override.
